source: dist/react/index.d.ts (classNames), dist/styles.css (defaults and hooks), README.md (each property's table and use)

classes.name: zf-form
classes.doc: The `<form>` — and, in device and server modes, the `<div>` the draft loading line and restore prompt stand in until the form shows, so `.zf-form` rules (width, centring) place them exactly where the form will be.

classes.name: zf-form--submitting
classes.doc: On the form while a submission is in flight.

classes.name: zf-form--failed
classes.doc: On the form after a submission failed.

classes.name: zf-block
classes.doc: Root element of every block.

classes.name: zf-block--required
classes.doc: Root element of a block that is required.

classes.name: zf-block--invalid
classes.doc: Root element of a block with validation errors.

classes.name: zf-label
classes.doc: A block's `<label>` or `<legend>` — the question's label.

classes.name: zf-required
classes.doc: The required marker: an empty `aria-hidden` `<span>` at the end of a required question's label or legend, and of a required grid column's header and card labels. The stylesheet draws its " *" with `::after`, so it is never part of an accessible name.

classes.name: zf-help
classes.doc: A question's help text (its `description`): a `<div id="<block id>__help">` under the label, before the control. The control's `aria-describedby` lists it before any error. Presentational blocks never show help.

classes.name: zf-input
classes.doc: Text-like `<input>`s: short, email, phone, link, number, date, time.

classes.name: zf-textarea
classes.doc: The `<textarea>`: long.

classes.name: zf-select
classes.doc: `<select>`: dropdown, country.

classes.name: zf-option
classes.doc: Each option's wrapping `<label>`: choice, checkbox, multiselect, scale.

classes.name: zf-option-input
classes.doc: The radio or checkbox inside an option.

classes.name: zf-clear-selection
classes.doc: The button that clears an optional question's answer, shown only while it has one: "Clear selection" after a choice's options or a matrix's table, "Clear" in a grid radio cell of an optional column.

classes.name: zf-error
classes.doc: The container holding a block's validation errors.

classes.name: zf-error-message
classes.doc: One individual error message.

classes.name: zf-error-summary
classes.doc: The summary of errors shown at the top of the form, or of the current page.

classes.name: zf-error-summary-title
classes.doc: The summary's heading, "There is a problem".

classes.name: zf-error-summary-list
classes.doc: The summary's list of links, one per error.

classes.name: zf-matrix
classes.doc: The matrix `<table>`.

classes.name: zf-matrix-row
classes.doc: A matrix `<tr>`, header row included.

classes.name: zf-matrix-cell
classes.doc: A matrix `<td>`: the row label and each radio cell.

classes.name: zf-grid
classes.doc: The grid `<table>` (contract section 14), with explicit table roles so it stays a table to assistive technology when the stylesheet lays its rows out as cards.

classes.name: zf-grid-scroll
classes.doc: The grid's own box around the table (contract 14.5): a keyboard-scrollable region named by the grid's label. The card layout switches on its width (a container query), never the viewport's; above that, a table still too wide scrolls inside it.

classes.name: zf-grid-row
classes.doc: A grid `<tr>`, the header row included.

classes.name: zf-grid-card
classes.doc: A body row of the grid (alongside `zf-grid-row`): a card when the grid's own width is below the narrow breakpoint.

classes.name: zf-grid-cell
classes.doc: A grid answer `<td>`: one radio group, `<select>` or `<input>`.

classes.name: zf-grid-cell-label
classes.doc: The column's label inside each cell, `aria-hidden`: shown only in the narrow card layout, where the column headers are visually hidden. The control's own name says it.

classes.name: zf-grid-cell--invalid
classes.doc: A grid cell with an error ("Required." or another problem with that cell).

classes.name: zf-grid-column--required
classes.doc: A required column's header `<th>` and each of its cells: where the required marker shows.

classes.name: zf-rating-star
classes.doc: One rating button.

classes.name: zf-rating-star--selected
classes.doc: A rating button at or below the chosen rating, i.e. a filled star.

classes.name: zf-ranking-item
classes.doc: One ranking button.

classes.name: zf-ranking-item--ranked
classes.doc: A ranking button that currently holds a rank.

classes.name: zf-ranking-position
classes.doc: The rank number inside a ranking button.

classes.name: zf-ranking-status
classes.doc: A polite `role="status"` line in each ranking question, one per repeat instance: announces each change ("Speed ranked 2 of 3."). Visually hidden by the stylesheet; empty until needed.

classes.name: zf-heading
classes.doc: The heading block's heading element.

classes.name: zf-title
classes.doc: The title block's heading element.

classes.name: zf-display-text
classes.doc: The label block's content. Deliberately not `zf-label`, which is a question's label.

classes.name: zf-divider
classes.doc: The divider block's `<hr>`.

classes.name: zf-text
classes.doc:
The text block's `

`: the author's plain text, line breaks kept.

classes.name: zf-image
classes.doc: The image block's ``.

classes.name: zf-video
classes.doc: The video block's root: the player frame, or the native `<video>`.

classes.name: zf-video--embed
classes.doc: On a YouTube or Vimeo video: a `<div>` holding the player's `<iframe>` at 16:9.

classes.name: zf-video--file
classes.doc: On a video file: the native `<video>` itself.

classes.name: zf-audio
classes.doc: The audio block's native `<audio>`: full width, up to the form's width.

classes.name: zf-group
classes.doc: A group's `<fieldset>`. Deliberately not `zf-block`: a group is not a question.

classes.name: zf-group--root
classes.doc: On a group at the form's root, i.e. not inside another group.

classes.name: zf-group-legend
classes.doc: A group's `<legend>`, which holds the group label as a heading (h2–h6 by depth).

classes.name: zf-repeat
classes.doc: On a repeating group's `<fieldset>`, alongside `zf-group` (and `zf-group--root` at the root): a repeating group is a group, so group rules apply to it too.

classes.name: zf-repeat-instance
classes.doc: One instance of a repeating group: a `<fieldset>` nested in the group's.

classes.name: zf-repeat-legend
classes.doc: A repeating group's `<legend>` (alongside `zf-group-legend`), and each instance's `<legend>`, which holds "{RepeatLabel} {n}" one heading level below the group's.

classes.name: zf-repeat-add
classes.doc: The Add button at the end of a repeating group: "Add {label}" or "Add another {label}".

classes.name: zf-repeat-remove
classes.doc: An instance's Remove button; its accessible name says which instance.

classes.name: zf-repeat-limit
classes.doc: "You can add up to {n}.", shown under Add once the limit is reached.

classes.name: zf-repeat-status
classes.doc: A polite `role="status"` line in each repeating group: announces a removal, and the limit when an Add reaches it. Visually hidden by the stylesheet; empty until needed.

classes.name: zf-page
classes.doc: The current page of a paged form: a `<section>`.

classes.name: zf-page-title
classes.doc: The page's title, an `<h2>` that receives focus on every page change.

classes.name: zf-nav
classes.doc: In a paged form, the container around Back and Next (or Submit).

classes.name: zf-next
classes.doc: The Next button.

classes.name: zf-back
classes.doc: The Back button. Carries `hidden` on the first displayed page.

classes.name: zf-progress
classes.doc: "Step x of y": a `<span>` inside the page's (or review step's) `<h2>`, before the title.

classes.name: zf-progress-bar
classes.doc: The segmented progress bar: an `<ol aria-hidden="true" style="display: none">`, shown by the stylesheet when the schema asks for it (see below) or a host's `data-zf-progress-style="bar"` does, and never under `data-zf-progress-style="caption"`.

classes.name: zf-progress-bar--schema
classes.doc: On the bar when the schema's `progressStyle` is "bar": shown unless a host says "caption".

classes.name: zf-progress-segment
classes.doc: One step's segment of the bar: an `<li>`. Pending when it has no modifier.

classes.name: zf-progress-segment--complete
classes.doc: A completed step's segment: visited and currently passing validation.

classes.name: zf-progress-segment--current
classes.doc: The current step's segment.

classes.name: zf-visually-hidden
classes.doc: Text for screen readers only, e.g. the page title after a review step's Change.

classes.name: zf-review
classes.doc: The review step: a `<section>` listing every displayed page's answers.

classes.name: zf-review-title
classes.doc: The review step's title, "Review your answers": an `<h2>` focused on arrival.

classes.name: zf-review-section
classes.doc: One page's answers on the review step: a `<section>` titled by the page.

classes.name: zf-review-question
classes.doc: One question and its answer: a `<div>` holding a `<dt>` and `<dd>`.

classes.name: zf-review-answer
classes.doc:
The answer `
` — the formatted answer, or "Not answered" — and the `

` saying "None added" under a repeating group with no instances.

classes.name: zf-review-answer--multiline
classes.doc: On an answer whose line breaks are part of it, e.g. a long answer's paragraphs.

classes.name: zf-review-group
classes.doc: A group on the review step: a `role="group"` container holding its subheading and its entries, nested as in the schema.

classes.name: zf-review-change
classes.doc: The Change button that opens a page from the review step.

classes.name: zf-actions
classes.doc: The container around the submit and clear buttons.

classes.name: zf-submit
classes.doc: The submit button.

classes.name: zf-clear
classes.doc: The clear button.

classes.name: zf-status
classes.doc: The submission failure message. It takes focus when a submission fails.

classes.name: zf-sending
classes.doc: A polite `role="status"` line before the actions: "Sending…" while a submission is in flight, empty otherwise. Always present, so the change is announced.

classes.name: zf-fields
classes.doc: The `<fieldset>` around the questions (and the review step), `disabled` while a submission is in flight so no answer can change after Submit. The stylesheet removes its border, margin and padding and lays it out like the form.

classes.name: zf-unavailable
classes.doc: Shown in place of the form, with `role="alert"`, when the renderer refuses the schema or its configuration (contract section 7): "This form can't be shown right now. Please try again later."

classes.name: zf-unavailable-detail
classes.doc: Development builds only: the refusal's own text, inside `zf-unavailable`.

classes.name: zf-success
classes.doc: The submission success message. It takes focus after a successful submit.

classes.name: zf-scores
classes.doc: The scores shown after a successful submit (contract 17.5): a `<ul>` right after the success message, one plain-text `<li>` per score. Absent when no score is shown.

classes.name: zf-draft-loading
classes.doc: Device and server drafts: shown in place of the form while the draft lookup runs; holds a `role="status"` line.

classes.name: zf-draft-prompt
classes.doc: The restore prompt, shown in place of the form when a draft is found.

classes.name: zf-draft-prompt-title
classes.doc: The restore prompt's `<h2>`.

classes.name: zf-draft-continue
classes.doc: The prompt's Continue button: restores the draft.

classes.name: zf-draft-start-over
classes.doc: The prompt's Start over button: deletes the draft and starts a new fill.

classes.name: zf-draft-notice
classes.doc: A drafts notice at the top of the form (`role="status"`): a draft that could not be opened or kept, progress that cannot be saved on this visit, or a failed save. The failed-save one is always present while drafts are saved, empty until needed.

properties.name: --zf-primary
properties.usedFor: Primary buttons, selected options, the success message

properties.name: --zf-group-rule
properties.usedFor: The rule down a group's leading edge

properties.name: --zf-group-box-border
properties.usedFor: Boxed groups, repeat instances, grid cards

properties.name: --zf-progress-current
properties.usedFor: The current step of the progress bar

properties.name: --zf-max-width
properties.usedFor: The form's, success message's and scores list's widest

properties.name: --zf-form-end-space
properties.usedFor: Space after the buttons, inside the form
